images.E2a: Epic cinematic space art, vivid and luminous, highly detailed. A large glowing planet Earth fills the left half of the frame, close and slightly tilted, a brilliant golden sunrise flaring over its curved edge. From many different cities and continents, bright beams and ribbons of light rise into space, each a different vivid color: gold, turquoise, magenta pink, violet, emerald green, sky blue, like countless different worlds shining at the same time. Behind it a colorful nebula in purple, teal and rose with a dense sparkling Milky Way. The right half of the frame is darker deep-space blue with soft stars. No text, no letters, no watermark, no logo.
